roleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration
jobDescription: The supply chain collaboration service connects manufacturers with their suppliers for forecast sharing and order confirmation. The Technical Project Manager plans supplier onboarding projects for the manufacturers' supplier networks, tracks integration milestones with the integration engineers, runs the weekly project review with the programme lead and customer operations, keeps the programme tracker as the single record of supplier status, and is expected to shorten the average supplier onboarding time, reported against the programme's recorded baseline.
requirements: Plans supplier onboarding projects and maintains the milestone schedule for each supplier.
Tracks integration milestones with the integration engineers and records status weekly.
Shortens the average supplier onboarding time, reported against the recorded programme baseline.
Coordinates onboarding decisions with the programme lead and customer operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each completed onboarding.

evidence.text: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining the milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) for each supplier in the programme tracker.

Tracked integration milestones with the three integration engineers, updating supplier status in the tracker each week, raising slipped milestones in the weekly project review and agreeing recovery dates with the supplier contact and the engineer concerned.

Average supplier onboarding time fell from 46 days to 29 days across the seventeen suppliers onboarded after the standard mapping templates were introduced, as recorded in the programme tracker against the recorded baseline of 46 days for the first six suppliers.
Coordinated onboarding decisions with the programme lead and customer operations; the programme lead decided supplier sequencing and customer operations confirmed each go-live with the manufacturer.
Wrote the completion note for each onboarded supplier, listing open mapping limitations and the hand-over points for the support team.

Work sample: the programme tracker export (onboarding days per supplier, baseline line, template introduction marker) and one supplier completion note, with the tracker's record identifiers as a verification trail.

Reference call with former programme lead: confirmed the onboarding-day figures come from the programme tracker, that the standard mapping templates were introduced by the candidate, and the employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate can travel to the manufacturer sites and has a six-week notice period.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each completed onboarding are only partly documented in the completion notes.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the onboarding-time result as stated for the seventeen suppliers after the templates; do not extend it to the programme as a whole.
